type: bar
title: '<script>HOSTILE_CTITLE()</script> "quoted" & </script>'

  inline:
    - { '<script>HOSTILE_XKEY()</script>': '<b onclick=HOSTILE_CAT1()>A</b>', 'y"><img src=x>': 1, 'series</script>': '<script>HOSTILE_SER1()</script>' }
    - { '<script>HOSTILE_XKEY()</script>': '"><script>HOSTILE_CAT2()</script>', 'y"><img src=x>': 2, 'series</script>': '"><img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_SER2()>' }
